test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which Indian state was the first to establish the institution of Panchayat raj?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **On October 2, 1959, at Nagaur** in Rajasthan, then-**Prime Minister Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru inaugurated the Panchayati Raj system,** which was later called **Panchayati Raj**.
 
• In September and October 1959, the first elections under the Rajasthan Panchayat Samitis and Zilla Parishads Act were held.
 
• The three-tier scheme of Panchayati Raj began functioning on October 2, 1959, with the already existing Panchayats at the village level under the Rajasthan Panchayat Act, 1953.
 
• Rajasthan holds the distinction of being the first state to approve the democratic decentralization concept, which calls for a three-tier structure of representative bodies at the village, block, and district levels. 
 
• The **Rajasthan Panchayat Act **was passed in **1953**, and village panchayats were formed across the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
